html:
Unleash your inner designer with Tint a Car’s range of coloured glass films! Whether you need a creative window film design for your storefront, coloured glass film for windows in your home, or frosted film for your office, look no further than Tint a Car for coloured and patterned window films.

With over 50 years of expertise, Tint a Car is a trusted name in window tinting across Australia. We provide top-notch products and services backed by our lifetime warranties, available at all stores nationwide. Plus, we offer Buy Now, Pay Later options through Afterpay and Zip Pay and all Tint a Car films are certified by ARPANSA, ensuring you don’t have to wait till payday to get the highest quality tints.

Designer Glass Films

Looking to spruce up your space with something unique and stylish? Tint a Car’s designer glass films are perfect for injecting a bit of creativity into any setting. Whether you want to brand your office, enhance privacy, or simply add some decorative flair, our patterned window films offer a versatile and attractive solution.

Our custom cutting service lets you transform these films into any shape, text, number, or repeating pattern you can imagine. This means you can personalise your space in ways that standard films can’t match. And when you fancy a change, it’s as easy as peeling off the old film and putting on a new one.

Where Can You Use Patterned Window Films?

  • Homes: Give your living room, bathroom, or kitchen a unique personality with custom designs that reflect your style.
  • Offices: Elevate your workspace with branded or decorative films that mirror your company’s identity, adding a professional yet stylish touch.
  • Retail Stores: Capture the attention of passersby with eye-catching window displays, while also ensuring privacy in areas like fitting rooms.

Why Choose Patterned or Coloured Window Films?

  • Aesthetic Appeal: Instantly enhance the look of any window with a variety of designs and colours, adding a unique touch to your space.
  • Privacy: Keep your interiors private without sacrificing natural light, making these films ideal for both homes and businesses.
  • UV Protection: Our films block up to 99% of harmful UV rays, helping to protect your furniture and interior from fading.
  • Heat Reduction: Enjoy a cooler, more comfortable environment by cutting down on the amount of heat that enters your space.

Our Patterned or Coloured Window Tints

Tint a Car stands out with its unparalleled expertise and commitment to quality. Here’s why you should choose us for your patterned or coloured window tints:

Our experts will guide you through the process, ensuring you select the ideal window film. Whether for privacy, aesthetic appeal, or UV protection, we have the right solution. With lifetime warranties and government-certified products exclusive to Tint a Car from the world’s largest window film supplier, you can trust that you’re getting top quality and protection.

You can easily bring your artistic vision to life with our extensive range of decorative window films. Choose from an array of patterns and colours to make your windows unique and easily refresh your décor by changing your window film whenever you want.

Get Started Today!

Transform your windows with patterned window film by contacting your local Tint a Car specialist. Our team of professionals ensures a flawless installation process, delivering the best results every time.

Call 13 TINT or find your nearest store to begin your journey with Tint a Car. Discover the difference our designer glass films can make in your home or business.
